aboutYou.title: About you
aboutYou.description: These questions help us understand who is using Bloom and what kinds of support they need from us.
aboutYou.descriptionALine1: Thank you for your answers so far!
aboutYou.descriptionALine2: As a new user, we'd like to understand how you're doing before using our services. Asking this now helps us to measure the impact that using Bloom is having for survivors, and helps us focus on the right things.

demographicForm.genderLabel: Please select one or more options that reflect your gender identity
demographicForm.genderHelpText: We are asking this to better understand how our users identify, with a view to designing even more inclusive and gender-affirming resources. You can select 'Prefer not to answer'.
demographicForm.neurodivergentLabel: Do you have a neurotype that affects the way your brain processes information? This might be a learning difficulty (I.e. Dyslexia, Dyspraxia, Dyscalculia), ADHD, or Autism.
demographicForm.neurodivergentHelpText: We do our best to design inclusive services, so it’s helpful to know this.
demographicForm.raceEthnNatnLabel: How would you describe your race, ethnicity and nationality? E.g., White Hispanic Mexican, or Tamil Indian.
demographicForm.raceEthnNatnHelpText: We know that people's experiences of race and ethnicity vary widely based on where they live, so write what you feel best describes you personally.
demographicForm.countryLabel: What country do you live in right now?
demographicForm.countryHelpText: This will help us understand where survivors are accessing our services from.

baseForm.scaleDescriptionLine1: Please rate your level of agreement with the following statements:

scaleLabels.Q1: I understand how the trauma I experienced has affected my mind, body and emotions
scaleLabels.Q2: I know that there are coping mechanisms that don’t help me in the long term, and that feeling drawn to these can be a normal response to trauma
scaleLabels.Q3: I know that it takes time, energy and patience to heal
scaleLabels.Q4: I’m committed to giving myself the attention that I need to heal
scaleLabels.Q5: I have found the things that make me feel good, and make time for them in my routine
scaleLabels.Q6: I understand that part of healing from trauma is dealing with triggers
scaleLabels.Q7: I understand that what makes make me feel safe or threatened is unique to me
scaleLabels.Q8: I can anticipate and cope with triggering moments, places or times of year

Courses.title: Our courses
Courses.introduction: Bloom courses offer tailored information, tools, and affirming words to help us cope with trauma. They encourage us to learn, reflect, and process what we’ve been through and how it may have affected us–all in a safe and empowering space.
Courses.noCourses: There are no courses to display right now. If this doesn't seem right, try again later or contact the Bloom team.

chat.title: Reflect with us
chat.description: If you’d like to share your reflections on this session, the Bloom team would love to hear from you!
chat.videoIntro: Find out more about how messaging works:
chat.detailPrivacy: Your messages are private and secure, they’re only ever seen by the Bloom team and you remain anonymous.
chat.detailTimezone: We work across many different timezones, so you should get a response from us within 6 hours, and it won’t be longer than 24 hours.
chat.detailLanguage: We are always available in English, French, Hindi, Portuguese or Spanish, but members of our team also speak Arabic, and Bangla; we’d be happy to arrange for you to speak with them.
chat.detailLegal: If you’re going through an active legal case, consider what you share with us as this can sometimes affect your case.
chat.detailImmediateHelp: If you’re in imminent threat or harm, please go to ‘Immediate help’ in the menu to find the right service to support you.

Messaging.messageHeading: Tell us what’s on your mind

frontChat.welcomeMessage:
Hi there, chat here with survivors and allies from our Bloom team who are experienced in supporting one another. We’re here for you to share your questions, feelings and reflections as you work through our courses.

If you are at immediate risk of harm, please call emergency services if you can and if it’s safe for you to do so. While we don’t offer crisis support, we can help connect you to the kind of support service you need. You can look up support services in your area in our global directory here: c.chayn.co/directory.

You can chat with us in English, French, German, Hindi, Portuguese and Spanish.

We will always aim to respond to your message within 1-2 days.
